headline: Broad segment strength drives a second FY guidance raise
summary_short: ADM reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $22.68B (+7.2% y/y) and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.87 (vs $0.45 y/y), as broad-based segment growth — Crushing profit +$330M, Carbohydrate Solutions +22%, Nutrition +51% — drove the company to raise full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.60.
summary_long: Revenue rose 10.7% q/q and 7.2% y/y to $22.68B. GAAP EPS jumped to $1.87 from $0.45 y/y (adjusted EPS $1.84, +98% y/y) as segment operating profit rose 75% y/y to $1.45B, led by Crushing (+$330M) on a constructive biofuels margin environment under the finalized 2026-2027 RVOs, plus roughly $100M of net positive mark-to-market and timing impacts. Carbohydrate Solutions profit rose 22% y/y to $411M on ethanol margins and policy incentives; Nutrition rose 51% y/y to $172M on Flavors growth and Animal Nutrition portfolio actions. Cash rose to $1.06B; long-term debt fell to $6.45B. ADM raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.60 (from $4.15-$4.70) and held capex guidance at $1.3-$1.5B.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based segment growth: Crushing profit rose $330M y/y on ~5% higher oilseed volumes and a constructive biofuels margin environment; Ag Services profit +159% on global network execution and the Brazil export terminal ramp; Carbohydrate Solutions and Nutrition also grew.
GAAP EPS rose to $1.87 from $0.45 y/y as segment operating profit climbed 75% to $1.45B across all three segments, while prior-year impairment and restructuring charges did not recur.
Net earnings rose to $908M from $219M y/y, tracking the 75% rise in segment operating profit plus roughly $100M of net positive mark-to-market and timing impacts, mostly in Crushing.

Management raised FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.15-$5.60 (from $4.15-$4.70), citing the finalized 2026-2027 RVOs, a constructive biofuels environment, and continued momentum in Nutrition led by Flavors.
